intro.PURPOSE_BODY_2: The app takes care of the whole run: it builds your set of exercises, keeps count of every cycle and shows you how much you have gained in speed and accuracy. It works offline too and keeps your progress on the device, so you can train wherever and whenever you like.
setting.BOARD_INTRO: How the board behaves. The strip below is a real exercise — take the black rook — so every setting can be tried where it is chosen: miss on purpose and it takes your move back, miss often enough and it plays you the answer.
profile.UNREACHABLE_EXPLANATION: The server is not answering, so there is no way to tell whether your session is still open. It may be waking up, which takes up to a minute on the free plan. Meanwhile the board, free play, an imported set and your settings work just the same: they never leave this device.
